Package parking.domain.model

Class ParkingTicket

java.lang.Object
parking.domain.model.ParkingTicket
public class ParkingTicket extends Object
Represents one vehicle's stay in the parking lot, from entry to closing.

A ticket owns its TicketStatus lifecycle (ACTIVE -> CLOSED -> PAID) and is the only class allowed to compute its own amount: close(LocalDateTime) always delegates that calculation to the ticket's vehicle's rate, never hard-coding or duplicating the pricing logic itself.

  • Method Details

    • close

      public long close(LocalDateTime exitTime)
      Closes the ticket: records the exit time, computes the final amount via Vehicle.getRate(), and moves the ticket to TicketStatus.CLOSED.
      Parameters:
      exitTime - the moment the vehicle left
      Returns:
      the computed amount, in the same units as Rate.calculateAmount(long)
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the ticket is not currently TicketStatus.ACTIVE

    • getStayInMinutes

      public long getStayInMinutes()
      Computes how long the vehicle has stayed so far. If the ticket has not been closed yet, the stay is measured up to the current moment.
      Returns:
      minutes elapsed between entry and exit (or now, if still active)
